name: The Holy Ghost
overview: The Holy Ghost is revealed in Scripture as the Spirit of God who dwells within believers, enabling true worship in spirit and truth (John 4:24). Jesus promised the Holy Ghost as the Comforter and Teacher, sent by the Father to guide believers into all truth and remind them of Christ’s words (John 14:26). Receiving the Holy Ghost empowers Christians to be effective witnesses for Christ, spreading the gospel from Jerusalem to the ends of the earth (Acts 1:8). Repentance and baptism in Jesus’ name are closely connected with receiving the gift of the Holy Ghost, underscoring its vital role in the believer’s spiritual life and growth (Acts 2:38).
